entities.name: Ribosomal RNA methyltransferase G
observations: The 215-residue query sequence is an exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q6FYC0 and matches GidB homologs at 80.5–82.8% identity across the full length.
Contains the Pfam GidB domain PF02527.22 at positions 25–196.
Annotated as a cytoplasmic 16S rRNA guanine-N7 methyltransferase, EC 2.1.1.170.

entities.name: 16S rRNA G527 methylation
observations: Guanosine at position 527 of 16S rRNA plus S-adenosyl-L-methionine yields N7-methylguanosine at position 527 plus S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.
Rhea references include RHEA:10209, RHEA:10210, and RHEA:42732.

entities.name: GidB sequence properties
observations: Query protein length is 215 amino acids; calculated molecular mass is 24,263 Da; theoretical pI is 8.87.
These are sequence-derived estimates and do not establish catalytic mechanism independently.
